instruction: Set the default Heading 1 style in LibreOffice Writer to Liberation Sans Bold at 18pt.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Liberation Sans Bold at 18pt as the default Heading 1 style in LibreOffice Writer settings. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file for Heading 1 font configuration using a three-tier search strategy: (1) PRIMARY: Explicit Heading 1 paragraph style paths (e.g., paths containing 'Heading 1', 'Heading%201', or 'Heading.20.1' combined with Style/ParagraphStyle/StylePool keywords) which are the most specific and reliable location for Format > Styles modifications; (2) SECONDARY: DefaultFont/Heading settings as fallback, which control application-level defaults for all heading styles; (3) TERTIARY: Generic heading-related paths as last resort. The custom metric function check_heading_font__86ec10fff549da3f2e44c228becf4684 parses the XML config file and verifies three aspects: font family (Liberation Sans via CharFontName), font size (18pt via CharHeight), and font weight (Bold via CharWeight or font name), using partial credit scoring (0.33 for correct font family, 0.33 for correct size, 0.34 for correct weight). The metric now includes validation logging to track which location was used and provides detailed comments explaining the search strategy and XML structure.

scoring_breakdown.0.66: Correct font family AND correct size (18pt)
scoring_breakdown.1.0: Correct font family AND correct size AND correct weight (Bold)
